metadata.title: SnapLogic + Existing API Platform Co-existence Model
metadata.author: SnapLogic Solutions Engineering

content.title: SnapLogic + Existing API Platform Co-existence Model
content.content:
The recommended positioning is a complementary architecture — not competitive displacement. Airbus Helicopters has invested in an API-first platform for application connectivity. That investment is respected and not at risk.

**Two layer model:**

- **"Existing API platform"**: Application integration, API lifecycle management, developer portal, API policies and security. Works well for system-to-system API calls, event-driven application integration, partner API integration.

- **"SnapLogic layer (data ops platform)"**: Data integration (batch, streaming, CDC), schema transformation, high-volume data movement, and data enrichment and streaming data. Citizen developer access. Addresses integration scenarios that AH's integration platforms are not designed for.

The key principle for Airbus Helicopters: SnapLogic handles the data heavy lifting that API management platforms are not designed for — not publishes APIs into the existing APIM can govern and expose.
